design_philosophy: A top 1% modern SaaS login experience. It avoids generic 'startup' templates by utilizing a rigid split-screen Swiss layout, aggressive typography, and stark contrasts. Color is used strictly for function, and negative space is maximized.

layout_and_spacing.container: Split-screen layout: 100vh. Left side (Form) 40% width. Right side (Visuals) 60% width. On mobile, stack vertically with visual side hidden or reduced to a minimal banner.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Form container should have p-12 md:p-24. Elements within the form should have gap-6 or gap-8.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none (Strictly sharp edges for a Swiss/Brutalist modern feel)
layout_and_spacing.shadows: No shadows. Use 1px solid borders (border-zinc-200) for separation if needed.

login_form.wrapper: flex flex-col justify-center h-full max-w-md mx-auto w-full
login_form.inputs: bg-zinc-100 border-none rounded-none h-14 px-4 text-base transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-200 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-400
login_form.button: bg-black text-white rounded-none h-14 font-medium text-base hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 group w-full
login_form.oauth_button: bg-white border border-zinc-200 text-black rounded-none h-14 font-medium hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-3 w-full
login_form.divider: flex items-center gap-4 my-8 text-sm text-zinc-400 before:flex-1 before:h-px before:bg-zinc-200 after:flex-1 after:h-px after:bg-zinc-200

visual_side.wrapper: hidden lg:block relative w-full h-full bg-zinc-100 overflow-hidden
visual_side.quote_box: absolute bottom-12 left-12 right-12 text-white z-10

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons must have distinct hover backgrounds. Use group-hover on the submit button to translate an embedded arrow icon rightwards (translate-x-1).
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: Inputs must have a sharp 2px black focus ring.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Staggered fade-up for form elements (header, oauth, divider, email input, password input, submit). Use Framer Motion.

images.description: Minimalist architectural design showcasing geometric shapes. Serves as the high-contrast backdrop for the right-side split screen.

icons.usage: Use ArrowRight for submit button, Chrome/Github for OAuth, Eye/EyeOff for password toggle.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lucide-react` for icons and `framer-motion` for page load animations.
Implement a split-screen layout (lg:grid-cols-[2fr_3fr] or 40/60 split).
The left side must be pure white (#FFFFFF) housing the login form. The right side contains the abstract image with an overlay and a typographic quote.
Use strict rounded-none for all inputs and buttons to match the Swiss design archetype.
Input fields should be borderless with a light gray background (bg-zinc-100), transitioning to white with a 2px black ring on focus.
Ensure the JWT auth flow is functional: mock an API or implement a basic frontend validation that stores a fake token in localStorage and redirects to a simple '/dashboard' on success.
Include 'Email' and 'Password' fields, 'Sign In' button, and 'Continue with Google' OAuth button.
Show a clear error state (red text, red input border) if login fails.
Include `data-testid` attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid="login-email-input"`).
Do not use Shadcn card components; build the layout natively with Tailwind to ensure exact spacing and sharp edges.
